mapper.sql: SELECT q.id, q.title, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_point_id, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, q.type, q.visibility, q.user_id, q.create_time, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM submit_record sr WHERE sr.question_id = q.id AND sr.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.status = 'AC' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS solved FROM question q LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = q.knowledge_point_id WHERE q.deleted = 0
mapper.select: ORDER BY q.create_time DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.deleted = 0

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.description, q.input_desc, q.output_desc, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_point_id, q.template_json, q.type, q.visibility, q.user_id, q.source_image_url, q.create_time, q.update_time, kp.code AS knowledge_point_code, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name FROM question q LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = q.knowledge_point_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (title, description, input_desc, output_desc, difficulty, knowledge_point_id, template_json, type, visibility, user_id, source_image_url, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{inputDesc}, #{outputDesc}, #{difficulty}, #{knowledgePointId}, #{templateJson}, 'PERSONAL', #{visibility}, #{userId}, #{sourceImageUrl}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, input_desc = #{inputDesc}, output_desc = #{outputDesc}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId}, template_json = #{templateJson}, visibility = #{visibility}, source_image_url = #{sourceImageUrl}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'PERSONAL' AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.title, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_point_id, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM submit_record sr WHERE sr.question_id = q.id AND sr.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.status = 'AC' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS solved FROM question q LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = q.knowledge_point_id WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND (q.type = 'PUBLIC' OR (q.type = 'PERSONAL' AND q.visibility = 'SHARED')) AND q.id != #{excludeId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, solved ASC, ABS(q.difficulty - #{difficulty}) ASC, q.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
